summary: China Tower's H1 2026 net profit surged 30.1% to RMB 7.49B despite 1.8% revenue decline to RMB 48.69B, driven by 8.3% expense cuts and 25.2% lower depreciation.
Interim dividend jumped 44.3% YoY to RMB 0.19122 per share; shares fell 0.26% to $9.72 as investors weighed negative free cash flow against profit gains.
Core tower business revenue dropped 5% amid customer optimization, while 'Two Wings' businesses grew 14.2% to RMB 7.92B, now comprising 16.3% of total revenue.
Management expects H2 2026 cash flow improvement after temporary pressure; strategy focuses on 5G-A expansion and scaling smart tower and energy services.
Operating cash flow plunged to RMB 7.14B from RMB 28.68B YoY; CapEx fell 6% to RMB 11.65B with debt-to-asset ratio at conservative 41.4%.
